items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Hernando, the Shakespearian actor, Hernando -- black actor, do you remember? (Juano HERNANDEZ)

ctx.x: Sure, it could be quite inconvenient and embarrassing on both sides.
But I've gotten into fights. During the war I remember I went on a bond drive down to Virginia. And Hernando, the Shakespearian actor, Hernando -- black actor, do you remember? (Juano HERNANDEZ)
